open('programs/task-d2264f29.py','w').write('''from collections import Counter

def transform(grid):
    H=len(grid); W=len(grid[0])
    def q(c): return [Counter(row)[c]>=0.6*W for row in grid]
    def bestrun(c):
        rows=q(c); best=cur=0
        for x in rows:
            cur=cur+1 if x else 0
            best=max(best,cur)
        return best
    cand=[c for c in set(v for row in grid for v in row) if sum(q(c))>=2]
    fill=max(cand,key=bestrun)
    lrows=[row for row in grid if fill not in row]
    line=Counter(v for row in lrows for v in row).most_common(1)[0][0]
    hl=[r for r in range(H) if all(grid[r][c]!=fill for c in range(W))]
    vl=[c for c in range(W) if all(grid[r][c]!=fill for r in range(H))]
    marks={(r,c):grid[r][c] for r in hl for c in vl if grid[r][c]!=line}
    bars=[]
    for a,b in zip(hl,hl[1:]):
        for x1,x2 in zip(vl,vl[1:]):
            col=marks.get((a,x1))
            if col is not None and marks.get((a,x2))==col and marks.get((b,x1))==col and marks.get((b,x2))==col:
                bars.append((a,x1,x2,col))
    hb=sorted({r for r,_,_,_ in bars}|{hl[hl.index(r)+1] for r,_,_,_ in bars})
    vb=sorted({x for _,a,b,_ in bars for x in (a,b)})
    out=[[fill]*(len(vb)-1) for _ in range(len(hb)-1)]
    for r,x1,x2,col in bars:
        ri=hb.index(r)
        for k in range(len(vb)-1):
            if vb[k]>=x1 and vb[k+1]<=x2: out[ri][k]=col
    return out
''')
